approved_translation: True friendship brings joy; separation from a friend causes sorrow that no comfort can ease.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a Dog used to go into the stable where the king's Elephant lived. At first the Dog went there to get the food that was left after the Elephant had finished eating. End of Project Gutenberg's More Jataka Tales, by Re-told by Ellen C. Babbitt
